svg.title: Power wiring from LRS-35-12 through UPS module and 3S BMS to the fused distribution board
svg.desc: Schematic showing mains AC-DC supply feeding the UPS module DC input, the UPS battery port connecting through a 3S BMS to three series cells, and the UPS 12V output feeding the fused distribution board.
svg.text: Red = +12V / +12.6V line · Gray = common ground (−) · Blue = balance taps
